eligibility.eligible_years_text: Four-year college students enrolled the following fall; preference for sophomores/juniors
eligibility.graduation_rule_text: Must be enrolled in a four-year college in the fall after the program; graduating seniors are ineligible.
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; enrolled in a four-year college for the fall after the program; graduating seniors ineligible. Prior research is not required, with preference for students who completed sophomore or junior year.
eligibility.other_rule_text: Preference, not a hard requirement, for students who completed sophomore or junior year; full 10-week commitment.
